name: Cloniprazepam
metabolism: Hydroxy-cloniprazepam, dihydroxy-cloniprazepam, 3-keto-cloniprazepam, 7-amino-cloniprazepam, hydroxy-clonazepam, 7-amino-clonazepam and 3-hydroxy-7-amino-clonazepam were formed through oxidation, hydroxylation, and/or reduction of the nitro group.
summary: Cloniprazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative and prodrug of clonazepam and other metabolites. It has also been sold as a designer drug.
